title: Formulas
search: Search formulas: Pythagoras, Ohm, cutting speed…

calc.fill: Fill in all values but one.
calc.fails: These values don't fit the formula

line.name: Linear function (Gerade)
line.note: The graph is a straight line. m is the slope (Steigung), t where it crosses the y-axis (y-Achsenabschnitt).

slope.name: Slope from two points
slope.note: Rise over run between P₁(x₁|y₁) and P₂(x₂|y₂); x₁ and x₂ must differ.

lineZero.name: Zero of a linear function (Nullstelle)
lineZero.note: Where y = mx + t crosses the x-axis: set y = 0 and solve for x (m ≠ 0).

distance.name: Distance of two points
distance.note: The length of the segment P₁P₂ (Pythagoras in the coordinate system).

midpoint.name: Midpoint of a segment
midpoint.note: The midpoint M of P₁P₂; its y-coordinate likewise: y of M = (y₁ + y₂)/2.

vertexForm.name: Vertex form (Scheitelpunktform)
vertexForm.note: A parabola with its vertex S(xₛ|yₛ). a > 0 opens upwards, a < 0 downwards; |a| > 1 narrower, |a| < 1 wider than the normal parabola.

vertex.name: Vertex from the general form
vertex.note: For y = ax² + bx + c the vertex is S(−b/(2a) | c − b²/(4a)).

midnight.name: Quadratic formula (Mitternachtsformel)
midnight.note: Solves ax² + bx + c = 0 (a ≠ 0). The part under the root is the discriminant D = b² − 4ac: D > 0 two solutions, D = 0 one, D < 0 none.
methods: Quadratic formula: put a, b, c of ax² + bx + c = 0 in. Example x² − 4x + 3 = 0: x = (4 ± √(16 − 12))/2, so x₁ = 3, x₂ = 1.
pq formula: divide by a first (x² + px + q = 0), then x = −p/2 ± √((p/2)² − q). Same example: x = 2 ± √(4 − 3) = 2 ± 1.
Completing the square (quadratische Ergänzung): x² − 4x + 3 = 0 → (x − 2)² − 1 = 0 → x − 2 = ±1.
Factoring: if you see two numbers with product c and sum −b (for a = 1): x² − 4x + 3 = (x − 1)(x − 3), so x = 1 or x = 3.
Without the constant (c = 0): factor out x: x(ax + b) = 0, so x = 0 or x = −b/a.

discriminant.name: Discriminant
discriminant.note: Tells how many real solutions ax² + bx + c = 0 has: D > 0 two, D = 0 one, D < 0 none.

pq.name: pq formula
pq.note: For the normalised form x² + px + q = 0 (divide by a first).

binomial1.name: First binomial formula
binomial1.note: Square of a sum. Example: (x + 3)² = x² + 6x + 9.

binomial2.name: Second binomial formula
binomial2.note: Square of a difference. Example: (x − 3)² = x² − 6x + 9.

powerProduct.name: Powers: same base, multiply
powerProduct.note: Keep the base, add the exponents.

powerQuotient.name: Powers: same base, divide
powerQuotient.note: Keep the base, subtract the exponents (a ≠ 0).

powerProductBase.name: Powers: same exponent, multiply
powerProductBase.note: Multiply the bases, keep the exponent.

powerNegative.name: Negative exponent
powerNegative.note: A negative exponent means the reciprocal (a ≠ 0).

powerRoot.name: Root as a power
powerRoot.note: The n-th root of a is a to the power 1/n (a ≥ 0).

logDefinition.name: Logarithm
logDefinition.note: x is the exponent that turns b into a: x = log of a to the base b (a > 0, b > 0, b ≠ 1).

logProduct.name: Logarithm of a product
logProduct.note: Becomes the sum of the logarithms.

logQuotient.name: Logarithm of a quotient
logQuotient.note: Becomes the difference of the logarithms.

logPower.name: Logarithm of a power
logPower.note: The exponent comes out in front.

logChange.name: Change of base
logChange.note: Any base with a calculator: divide by lg (or ln) of the base.

pythagoras.name: Pythagorean theorem (Satz des Pythagoras)
pythagoras.note: In a right triangle: the squares of the two legs (Katheten) a and b add up to the square of the hypotenuse c, opposite the right angle.

legTheorem.name: Leg theorem (Kathetensatz)
legTheorem.note: In a right triangle: a leg squared equals the hypotenuse times the part p of it next to that leg (b² = c·q likewise).

altitudeTheorem.name: Altitude theorem (Höhensatz)
altitudeTheorem.note: In a right triangle: the altitude h onto the hypotenuse squared equals the product of the two hypotenuse sections p and q.

sine.name: Sine, cosine, tangent
sine.note: In a right triangle (right angle at C): sine = opposite/hypotenuse (Gegenkathete/Hypotenuse), cosine = adjacent/hypotenuse (Ankathete/Hypotenuse), tangent = opposite/adjacent.

lawOfSines.name: Law of sines (Sinussatz)
lawOfSines.note: In every triangle the ratio of a side to the sine of the opposite angle is the same (also c/sin γ).

lawOfCosines.name: Law of cosines (Kosinussatz)
lawOfCosines.note: In every triangle; with γ = 90° it becomes Pythagoras.

vars.gamma: angle γ between a and b

triangleSine.name: Area with two sides and the angle between them

vars.gamma: angle γ between a and b

radians.name: Degrees to radians (Bogenmaß)
radians.note: 180° is π; the other way: α = x·180°/π.

triangle.name: Triangle
triangle.note: Half of base times height; the height is at right angles to the base g.

parallelogram.name: Parallelogram
parallelogram.note: Base times height (not times the slanted side).

trapezoid.name: Trapezoid (Trapez)
trapezoid.note: a and c are the two parallel sides, h the distance between them.

kite.name: Kite and rhombus (Drachenviereck, Raute)
kite.note: Half the product of the diagonals e and f (they are at right angles).

circle.name: Circle
circle.note: Area πr²; circumference 2πr; with the diameter d = 2r: A = πd²/4.

sector.name: Circular sector (Kreissektor)
sector.note: The share α/360° of the circle; the arc length b likewise.

cuboid.name: Cuboid (Quader)
cuboid.note: Volume a·b·c; surface O = 2(ab + ac + bc).

prism.name: Prism (Prisma)
prism.note: Base area times height, for every prism.

cylinder.name: Cylinder (Zylinder)
cylinder.note: Volume πr²h; lateral surface (Mantel) M = 2πrh; surface O = 2πr² + 2πrh.

pyramid.name: Pyramid (Pyramide)
pyramid.note: A third of base area times height.

cone.name: Cone (Kegel)
cone.note: A third of a cylinder; s is the slant height (Mantellinie), M = πrs.

percent.name: Percent (Prozentrechnung)
percent.note: Prozentwert W, Grundwert G (the whole, 100 %), Prozentsatz p %.
methods: Growth factor: increase by p % means times (1 + p/100), decrease times (1 − p/100). 80 € + 15 % = 80 € · 1.15 = 92 €.

interest.name: Interest for a year (Jahreszinsen)
interest.note: Interest Z on the capital K at the rate p % per year.

interestDays.name: Interest for days (Tageszinsen)
interestDays.note: German banking method: every month has 30 days, the year 360 (t in days).

compound.name: Compound interest (Zinseszins)
compound.note: The interest is added each year and earns interest too.

growth.name: Exponential growth and decay
growth.note: y₀ at the start, times a for each step: a > 1 grows, 0 < a < 1 shrinks.

growthPercent.name: Growth factor from percent
growthPercent.note: Growth by p % per step; for decrease use a = 1 − p/100.

speed.name: Speed (Geschwindigkeit)
speed.note: For a uniform motion: distance per time. 1 m/s = 3.6 km/h.

accelDistance.name: Uniformly accelerated motion
accelDistance.note: Starting from rest: s = ½at², v = a·t, and v = √(2as).

freeFall.name: Free fall (freier Fall)
freeFall.note: Without air resistance, from rest; g = 9.81 m/s².

circularSpeed.name: Speed on a circle
circularSpeed.note: One turn (circumference 2πr) in the period T.

spring.name: Hooke's law (Hookesches Gesetz)
spring.note: Within the elastic range the extension s is proportional to the force; D is the spring constant (Federhärte).

lever.name: Law of the lever (Hebelgesetz)
lever.note: In balance: force times its lever arm (Kraftarm) on one side equals that on the other.

torque.name: Torque (Drehmoment)
torque.note: Force times the lever arm (at right angles to the force).

centripetal.name: Centripetal force (Zentripetalkraft)
centripetal.note: The force that keeps a body on a circle.

density.name: Density (Dichte)
density.note: Mass per volume. Water ≈ 1.00 g/cm³; 1 g/cm³ = 1000 kg/m³.

pressure.name: Pressure (Druck)
pressure.note: Force per area; 1 Pa = 1 N/m², 1 bar = 100 000 Pa.

hydrostatic.name: Pressure in liquids (Schweredruck)
hydrostatic.note: Grows with the depth h; does not depend on the shape of the container.

buoyancy.name: Buoyancy (Auftrieb, Archimedes)
buoyancy.note: Equals the weight of the displaced fluid.

work.name: Work (Arbeit)
work.note: Force along the path times the distance; 1 J = 1 N·m.

potential.name: Potential energy (Höhenenergie)
potential.note: Relative to the height you count from.

power.name: Power (Leistung)
power.note: Work per time; also P = F·v. 1 W = 1 J/s.

efficiency.name: Efficiency (Wirkungsgrad)
efficiency.note: Useful energy (or power) by the energy put in; always less than 1 (100 %).

heat.name: Heat (Wärme)
heat.note: Energy to warm a mass m by ΔT. Water: c = 4.19 kJ/(kg·K) = 4190 J/(kg·K).

vars.ΔT: temperature change (in K, the same number as in °C)

expansion.name: Thermal expansion (Längenausdehnung)
expansion.note: α is the linear expansion coefficient of the material (steel ≈ 0.000012 1/K).

ohm.name: Ohm's law (Ohmsches Gesetz)
ohm.note: Voltage = resistance × current, for a resistor at constant temperature.

series.name: Resistors in series (Reihenschaltung)
series.note: The resistances add up; the current is the same everywhere, the voltages add up.

parallel.name: Resistors in parallel (Parallelschaltung)
parallel.note: The reciprocals add up; the voltage is the same, the currents add up.

transformer.name: Transformer (Transformator)
transformer.note: Ideal transformer: the voltages are in the ratio of the turns, the currents the other way round.

frequency.name: Frequency (Frequenz)
frequency.note: The reciprocal of the period T.

wave.name: Wave speed
wave.note: Wavelength times frequency; light: c ≈ 3·10⁸ m/s, sound in air ≈ 343 m/s.

lens.name: Lens equation (Linsengleichung)
lens.note: For a thin converging lens: f focal length (Brennweite), g object distance (Gegenstandsweite), b image distance (Bildweite).

magnification.name: Image size (Abbildungsgleichung)
magnification.note: Image size B to object size G as image distance b to object distance g.

decay.name: Radioactive decay (Zerfallsgesetz)
decay.note: After each half-life Tₕ half of the nuclei are left. t and Tₕ in the same unit.

cuttingSpeed.name: Cutting speed (Schnittgeschwindigkeit)
cuttingSpeed.note: Turning, drilling, milling: d is the diameter of the workpiece (turning) or of the tool. The speed n from the cutting speed: n = 1000 · v꜀ / (π · d).

feedMilling.name: Feed rate, milling
feedMilling.note: Feed per tooth times number of teeth times speed.

mainTime.name: Machining time, turning (Hauptnutzungszeit)
mainTime.note: L is the tool path with approach and overrun (L = l + lₐ + lᵤ), i the number of cuts.

cuttingPower.name: Cutting power (Schnittleistung)
cuttingPower.note: Cutting force times cutting speed; with the cutting speed in m/min and the power in kW.

stress.name: Stress (Spannung)
stress.note: Force per cross-section S; 1 N/mm² = 1 MPa.

tensileStrength.name: Tensile strength (Zugfestigkeit)
tensileStrength.note: The highest force of the tensile test by the starting cross-section.

elongation.name: Strain (Dehnung)
elongation.note: Change in length by the starting length, in %.

hooke.name: Hooke's law for materials
hooke.note: In the elastic range; ε as a plain ratio (not %). Steel: E ≈ 210 000 N/mm².

allowable.name: Allowable stress (zulässige Spannung)
allowable.note: Yield strength by the safety factor ν (Sicherheitszahl).

beltDrive.name: Belt drive (Riementrieb)
beltDrive.note: Without slip: diameter times speed is the same on both pulleys.

ratio.name: Transmission ratio (Übersetzung)
ratio.note: i > 1 slows down (Übersetzung ins Langsame), i < 1 speeds up.

gearDrive.name: Gear drive (Zahnradtrieb)
gearDrive.note: Number of teeth times speed is the same on both gears.

totalRatio.name: Total ratio
totalRatio.note: Of several stages: the product of their ratios.

powerTorque.name: Power from torque
powerTorque.note: With P in kW, M in N·m and n in 1/min. In SI units: P = 2π·n·M (n in 1/s).

pitchDiameter.name: Pitch diameter (Teilkreisdurchmesser)
pitchDiameter.note: Spur gear: module times number of teeth.

rootDiameter.name: Root diameter (Fußkreisdurchmesser)
rootDiameter.note: With the tip clearance c = 0.25 · m the root diameter is the pitch diameter minus 2.5 · m.

circularPitch.name: Pitch (Teilung)
circularPitch.note: The distance from tooth to tooth on the pitch circle.

centerDistance.name: Centre distance (Achsabstand)
centerDistance.note: Of two external spur gears with the same module.

maxClearance.name: Maximum clearance (Höchstspiel)
maxClearance.note: Largest bore minus smallest shaft. B = bore (Bohrung), W = shaft (Welle).

minClearance.name: Minimum clearance (Mindestspiel)
minClearance.note: Smallest bore minus largest shaft; negative means interference (Übermaß).

taper.name: Taper (Kegelverjüngung)
taper.note: C = 1 : x means the diameter changes by 1 mm over x mm length.

taperAngle.name: Taper angle (Kegelwinkel)
taperAngle.note: α/2 is the setting angle (Einstellwinkel) for turning the taper.

absolutePressure.name: Absolute pressure
absolutePressure.note: Gauges show the overpressure pₑ; the ambient pressure is about 1 bar (1.013 bar).

pistonArea.name: Piston area
pistonArea.note: Return stroke (rod side): A = π · (D² − d²) / 4 with D the piston and d the rod diameter.

pistonForce.name: Effective piston force (Kolbenkraft)
pistonForce.note: 1 bar = 10 N/cm², so with pₑ in bar and A in cm² the factor 10 gives newtons; η is the efficiency (friction).

airConsumption.name: Air consumption (Luftverbrauch)
airConsumption.note: The compressed volume of one stroke direction, turned into free air by the pressure ratio. Double-acting cylinders: add both directions (the rod side with the smaller ring area); divide by 1000 for l/min.

boyle.name: Boyle-Mariotte
boyle.note: At constant temperature; with absolute pressures.

hydraulicPress.name: Hydraulic press
hydraulicPress.note: The pressure is the same everywhere: small force on a small piston, large force on a large one. The paths go the other way (s₁A₁ = s₂A₂).

continuity.name: Continuity (Kontinuitätsgleichung)
continuity.note: The same volume flows through every cross-section: narrower means faster.

amount.name: Amount of substance (Stoffmenge)
amount.note: Mass by molar mass; the molar mass is in the periodic table (H₂O: 18.02 g/mol).

molarVolume.name: Molar volume of gases
molarVolume.note: At 0 °C and 1013 hPa (standard conditions) the molar volume is 22.4 l/mol; at 20 °C about 24.0 l/mol.

idealGas.name: Ideal gas law
idealGas.note: Pressure in Pa, volume in m³, temperature in K.

concentration.name: Concentration (Stoffmengenkonzentration)
concentration.note: Amount of substance per volume of solution.

massFraction.name: Mass fraction (Massenanteil)
massFraction.note: Part of the mass of the mixture, in %.

ph.name: pH value
ph.note: Negative decimal logarithm of the H₃O⁺ concentration (in mol/l). At 25 °C: pH 7 neutral, below acidic, above basic; pH + pOH = 14.
